newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude neutral, resistance at $20.30.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude neutral, resistance at $20.30.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+NYMEX September crude oil futures face resistance up at around Friday's closing levels and traders see $20.50 as an important objective to the upside.
+Gasoline put in a fiery performance last week and analysts suggested taking a neutral or positive stance for the time being.

NYMEX crude oil futures face resistance between $20.30 and $20.50 and this, combined with support at around $19.90, forms a band which may keep prices neutral for the time being, technical analysts said.
But traders are awaiting important fundamental news and this could disrupt the technical picture.
"Participants should be wary of a fundamental news story that could cause a quick knee-jerk reaction to the down side," brokers GNI in London said in a daily report.

September NYMEX crude oil closed 14 cents a barrel firmer on Friday at $20.28 but September gasoline, the new front month, put in the star performance, gaining 2.27 cents a gallon to close at 65.07. September heating oil was just 0.05 cents down at 56.56.
"The resistance level is $20.30-$20.50 and this is holding the market down for now," said Claudia LaCovey at the Analytics Research Corp. in Bethesda, Maryland.

A break of these levels by 20-30 cents would provide an opportunity to play from the long side, with first support at $20.13 and then $19.82-90 below that, she said, employing the Hans Kashyap proprietary chart techique.
A failure to break above these levels, she said, and support would weigh in first at $19.90 and then $19.45-50.

MeesPierson Derivatives in London, employing the Market Profile technique, said: "Today we look to buy dips to $19.92 but if trading in this slightly higher range continues, $20.01 might be a suitable level.
Gasoline, LaCovey said, was looking positive in the short term. Minor resistance would be encountered at 66.56, and then stiffer resistance would appear at 67.21.
Support lay at 63.10 and 62.68, below which lay a stronger level of support at 61.83.
